channel.description: Independent local news, public-service information and reporting from Rochdale borough.

item.title: Rochdale Town Hall to host Ignite Fire Festival from November 20 to 22
item.description: The Ignite Fire Festival returns to Rochdale Town Hall and gardens, featuring a light and fire trail, live performances, and festive activities.

item.title: Scrooge screening with live orchestra comes to Heywood Civic
item.description: The 1951 film starring Alastair Sim will be shown with a live score from the three-piece FB Pocket Orchestra on Saturday 14 November.

item.title: Newhouse Crescent, roadworks in Rochdale from 27 October 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has announced that roadworks on Newhouse Crescent will start on 27 October 2026, affecting local traffic for up to 21 days.

item.title: New industrial units planned at Caldershaw Business Centre in Rochdale
item.description: Nine new industrial units are set to be built at Caldershaw Business Centre, aiming to boost local employment and support entrepreneurs.

item.title: Rochdale council deputy leader detained briefly in Pakistan during civic visit
item.description: Councillor Daalat Ali was held for a short time upon arrival in Pakistan as part of a delegation aimed at strengthening ties with Sahiwal.

item.title: Rochdale’s Deckers Hospitality Group acquires historic drinks wholesaler Tate-Smith
item.description: The Rochdale-based family group has bought the Malton drinks wholesaler, with existing staff staying and Harry Tate-Smith continuing as trading director.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Wednesday 28 October 2026
item.description: 3 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Heywood lollipop man forced to leap out of way as drivers ignore crossing
item.description: A car and a moped have been seized after their drivers failed to stop for a lollipop man in Heywood, forcing him to jump aside for safety.

item.title: Police arrest 17 in operation against crime gang in Rochdale and Heywood
item.description: Seventeen arrests were made during a police operation targeting an organised crime group linked to violence in Heywood earlier this year.

item.title: Roadworks on Manchester Road Old Section to begin on 25 October 2026
item.description: Temporary closure of part of Manchester Road Old Section in Rochdale from 25 October 2026 due to roadworks.

item.title: Rochdale Council awards contract for Queen's Park SEND improvement project
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has awarded a contract to enhance the play area at Queen's Park, Heywood, focusing on inclusivity for children with special educational needs.

item.title: Does a boggart still haunt Clegg Hall?
item.description: The stone house by the Rochdale Canal is real, its 19th‑century boggart story is real — but the murders that feed the tale are not supported by contemporary records.

item.title: Two Rochdale men among ten charged in drugs supply investigation
item.description: GMP says two Rochdale men are among ten people charged following a seven-month investigation. All ten have been remanded ahead of a Crown Court appearance.

item.title: Middleton prepares for Christmas lights switch-on event
item.description: Middleton is making final preparations for its Christmas lights switch-on event, scheduled for Saturday, November 14, in Middleton Gardens. item.title: Broad Lane roadworks in Rochdale set to begin on 11 January 2027
item.description: Roadworks on Broad Lane will temporarily close part of the road from January to May 2027, affecting local traffic.

item.title: Rochdale AFC set to face Port Vale in League Two clash
item.description: Rochdale AFC will play against Port Vale in an upcoming League Two match, with significant implications for both teams in the league standings.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Tuesday 27 October 2026
item.description: 2 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Rochdale AFC nominated for multiple awards at Northwest Football Awards 2026
item.description: Rochdale AFC has received several nominations at the Northwest Football Awards 2026, recognising the club's fan engagement and community initiatives.

item.title: Sunderland held to a draw by Rochdale in League One clash
item.description: Sunderland took the lead twice but were unable to secure victory against Rochdale in a League One match played behind closed doors due to COVID-19 restrictions.

item.title: Rochdale Boroughwide Housing updates on Representative Body developments
item.description: Andrew Johnson has been re-appointed as Chair of the RBH Representative Body, with Rachael Ray as Deputy Chair, as they work to improve services for residents.

item.title: Heywood prepares for Remembrance Day services on 8 November 2026
item.description: The borough of Rochdale will hold Remembrance Day services across various townships, inviting public participation to honour servicemen and women.

item.title: Hopwood Hall College celebrates topping out of new Clegg Building
item.description: A topping out ceremony at Hopwood Hall College marks a significant step in the construction of the new Clegg Building, set to enhance educational facilities in Rochdale.

item.title: Contractor dies in three-vehicle crash on Rochdale Road in Edenfield
item.description: A contractor has died following a collision involving a tractor, van, and lorry on Rochdale Road, with another worker injured. Emergency services responded to the incident on Monday morning.

item.title: Littleborough defeat Trafford MV in ADM Lancs/Cheshire 2 clash
item.description: Littleborough secured a victory against Trafford MV, maintaining their position at the top of ADM Lancs/Cheshire 2 despite challenging weather conditions.

item.title: Rochdale foster carers recognised for supporting over 1,000 children
item.description: At an awards ceremony in Rochdale Town Hall, 34 foster families were honoured for their commitment to caring for vulnerable children, collectively fostering for 465 years.

item.title: Heywood school pupil wins competition to name new road after community figure
item.description: Ava McEvoy, an eight-year-old from Our Lady and St Paul's RC Primary School, has won a competition to name a new road in Heywood, which will be called Murphy Close.

item.title: Heywood nursery loses planning bid to keep caravan as outbuilding
item.description: Little Oaks Nursery in Heywood has been denied permission to retain a caravan used as an outbuilding, following a planning decision by Rochdale Council.

item.title: GTAS weekly guide brings Halloween fun and a remembrance walk to Rochdale
item.description: Get Together After Serving has shared its programme for 26 October to 1 November, including afternoon tea, a remembrance walk, Halloween activities and football.

item.title: Heights Lane roadworks to begin on 26 October 2026
item.description: Roadworks on Heights Lane in Rochdale will result in temporary closures from 26 October to 1 November 2026, affecting local traffic.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Monday 26 October 2026
item.description: 9 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Free benefits checks at Littleborough and Wardle libraries on Monday and Tuesday
item.description: Council advisers will offer free, no booking needed benefits checks at Littleborough Library on 26 October and Wardle Library on 27 October, from 10am to noon.

item.title: Rochdale Council Tax Direct Debits delayed by one day after system error
item.description: Council Tax Direct Debits due on Monday 26 October will instead be collected on Tuesday 27 October, Rochdale Council says. The notice applies to the affected collection date.

item.title: Wednesday deadline to comment on parking changes in Rochdale, Littleborough and Milnrow
item.description: Residents have until Wednesday 28 October to comment on three proposed parking orders affecting Mere Street, Wardle Street and the Butterworth Hall area.

item.title: New book showcases unseen 1930s photographs of Rochdale's Norden Riviera
item.description: A new book featuring 600 unseen photographs captures the essence of 1930s Rochdale, including the lost Norden Riviera lido, highlighting the area's historical significance during a transformative decade.

item.title: New documentary explores the history of Hollingworth Lake
item.description: A new YouTube documentary delves into the fascinating history of Hollingworth Lake, revealing its origins and significance to the local community.

item.title: Road closures for Wardle Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has announced road closures in Wardle for Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026, affecting local traffic and access.

item.title: Milnrow foster carers honoured for 465 years of service
item.description: Foster carers in Milnrow were recently honoured for their remarkable collective service of 465 years at an awards ceremony held by Rochdale Borough Council. The event celebrated the commitment and dedication of these individuals who have provided care and support to children in need. Among those recognised were Michael and Marilyn, who have fostered…

item.title: Tree falls across the top of Belfield Road
item.description: A large tree has come down at the top of Belfield Road in Rochdale, with its trunk and branches lying across the carriageway and pavement.

item.title: Rochdale awards event recognises achievements of over 200 cared for children
item.description: More than 200 children in care were celebrated at an awards event hosted by Rochdale Borough Council, recognising their achievements and resilience.

item.title: Rochdale vs Lionesses match postponed due to unforeseen circumstances
item.description: The match between Rochdale and the Lionesses, originally set to take place recently, has been postponed. This announcement was made by Salford City FC on their official website.

item.title: Traffic congestion on M62 near Rochdale following accident
item.description: An accident on the M62 has caused significant traffic delays on the eastbound carriageway between junctions 21 and 22, affecting commuters and local drivers.

item.title: Investigation launched after racist abuse incident at Rochdale nightclub
item.description: A woman has been filmed hurling racist abuse at a nightclub bouncer in Rochdale, prompting an investigation by Greater Manchester Police.

item.title: Remembrance Sunday services planned across Rochdale borough
item.description: Residents will gather on November 8 to honour those who served in the armed forces, with parades and services in multiple towns.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Sunday 25 October 2026
item.description: 10 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Women’s match against Salford postponed
item.description: The scheduled match between Rochdale AFC Women and Salford has been postponed, affecting both teams and their supporters.

item.title: Rochdale mum diagnosed with breast cancer after routine NHS screening
item.description: Sarah Hickman, 50, encourages women to attend NHS breast screenings after her cancer was detected early during a routine mammogram.

item.title: Road closures in Milnrow for Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026
item.description: Milnrow will see temporary road closures on 8 November 2026 for Remembrance Sunday, as announced by Rochdale Borough Council.

item.title: Road closures in Norden for Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026
item.description: Norden will see temporary road closures on 8 November 2026 for Remembrance Sunday, affecting Woodhouse Lane and surrounding areas.

item.title: Road closures for Middleton Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026
item.description: Temporary road closures will be in effect in Middleton for Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026, affecting local traffic and access.
